scenario: Affichage du menu déroulant des dates disponibles

actions.action: Open the dropdown by clicking the verified wrapper: #selectedDate >> xpath=ancestor::div[contains(concat(" ",normalize-space(@class)," ")," choices ")][1] >> css=.choices__inner.
Select the option inside the verified dropdown list: #selectedDate >> xpath=ancestor::div[contains(concat(" ",normalize-space(@class)," ")," choices ")][1] >> css=.choices__list--dropdown.

explanation: The native <select> is hidden by Choices.js, so direct visibility assertions / selectOption fail.
The knowledge base verified wrapper "pages./category/spectacle.select_selectedDate_choicesInner" is the actionable element.
